title: Bring the Islands Online
style: Cinematic painted key art for a modern real-time strategy game, the look of classic Command and Conquer box art: dramatic light, rich colour, crisp detail, wide 16:9 composition, no text, no logos, no letters, no flags, no insignia.

music.caption: mysterious naval tech cinematic underscore, glassy synth arpeggios, deep taiko pulse, low strings, electronic pulses like a network coming online, rising to a bright resolve, no vocals

shots.prompt: A chain of green islands at night seen from the sea, a few dead communication masts and dark radar domes, faint fog, a single blinking red light, isolated and silent.
shots.line: The command network is broken across the islands.

shots.prompt: Turn this top-down game map into a glowing holographic tactical map projected on a dark command table, seen at a slight angle. Keep the terrain layout, coastline and roads of the reference. Add a glowing blue water gate in a channel, a red command node marker, dotted blue network links between the islands, teal light.
shots.line: Obsidian Directorate holds the approaches. The water gate is the only way in for your amphibious vehicles.

shots.prompt: A network specialist soldier kneeling at a field terminal on a rocky island shore at night, plugging a cable into a relay mast that lights up blue, armoured vehicles waiting behind, cinematic.
shots.line: Deploy your network specialist. Every restored link makes the next move possible.

shots.prompt: Portrait of a fictional Chinese navy marine commander in his forties, short black hair, blue digital camouflage uniform and headset, standing on the deck of a ship at night with glowing screens and the sea behind him, focused and composed, looking at the viewer, cinematic rim light, painted portrait.
shots.line: Reconnaissance first. Then missiles, aircraft and ships, together.

shots.prompt: Two amphibious armoured vehicles surging through a narrow sea channel at dawn between rocky cliffs, a line of floating barriers opening, a warship covering them, spray and light, dramatic.
shots.line: Send the amphibious vehicles through the gate under covering fire.

shots.prompt: The island chain at dawn with every communication mast glowing blue and linked by light across the water, ships at anchor, a sense of victory and connection.
